Definition: {to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)}
BiblicalUsage: To send, in Ezra's Aramaic, is what kings and letters do. Nebuchadnezzar sent to gather the rulers to the dedication of his image, the men beyond the river sent a letter to Artaxerxes, and they sent a letter to Darius, all peace. Ezra himself was sent of the king and his seven counsellors to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sending is how God's work moved in exile. Letters crossed the river, a scribe was sent to Jerusalem, and I hold that God still sends His people where His law needs keeping.
